Usage: gaia extract status [OPTIONS] TASK_ID

 Check one LKM extraction task (GET /parse/task/{task_id}).

╭─ Arguments ──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ *    task_id      TEXT  Extraction task id returned by `gaia extract         │
│                         submit`.                                             │
│                         [required]                                           │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯
╭─ Options ────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╮
│ --index,--server        TEXT  Configured LKM index id. [default: bohrium]    │
│ --out                   PATH  Write JSON to PATH (atomic) instead of stdout. │
│ --no-hint                     Suppress Gaia follow-up suggestions on stderr. │
│ --help                        Show this message and exit.                    │
╰──────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────╯

 `status` reads the task once and exits; it does not block. Use `gaia extract
 submit --wait` when you want the CLI to poll for you.
 `stage` is progress narration (metadata, ocr, step0-step4, graph, done);
 branch on `status`, not on `stage`.
 `step_durations` lists the pipeline steps that have finished so far, in order,
 with their `duration_ms` — measured progress for a task that has been running
 a while.
 API docs:
